name: wowaddon
description: Agent-friendly CLI and TUI that installs and updates WoW addons from GitHub, CurseForge, WoWInterface, Tukui and Wago Addons

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test
scripts.gate: bun run check && bun scripts/changelog.ts --check && python3 .sift/gate.py --base origin/main && python3 .sift/agents.py check
